baseline.kind: unchanged engines continuous from 100000 each; derived baseline, no new alpha

bootstrap.method: moving noncircular blocks, uniform valid start
bootstrap.eligible: noise eligibility=eligible; orb conditionally_excluded=false; keep legitimate no-trade days
bootstrap.gaps: all five dates must be consecutive actual XNYS sessions; no block across missing or excluded day

stops.pnl: strictly below unrounded p5 at first20 and first60 sessions, once each; irreversible
stops.drawdown_metric: ordered one-minute close and fill marks, percent of running peak; same metric historical and EOD telemetry
stops.timing: EOD detection suspends next session entries; no change to that day frozen-model exits
stops.unknown: unresolved blocks subsequent sessions; never zero
stops.live: legacy operational bots not reconfigured in task7; no threshold on old account

parity.action: investigate and withhold validation; no automatic strategy rewrite
parity.comparison: prefer conditional capital-matched diagnostic; disclose missing input/code provenance
parity.legacy: no task7 threshold applied before registration first session

first_session: first XNYS session strictly after numeric rule commit NewYork date
